title: Etale finite coefficient Hom change by thick generation
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell$ distinct from its characteristic, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a separated finite-type scheme $X$ over its algebraically closed field [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For $n\ge m\ge0$, the actual etaleFiniteHomCanonical at positive exponents $n+1,m+1$ [def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow] is an isomorphism for every pair of finite-Tor bounded constructible etale complexes $K,M$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. No endpoint-domain assertion or formal-coherence clause is bundled into this statement.

source.place: Middle paragraphs: normalized comparison on locally closed generators and exactness in the first argument.

proof.text: The finite-type source over a field is Noetherian. The evaluation-defined family of etale comparisons has a thick isomorphism locus for each fixed M. Its transpose characterization identifies its components with the ordinary evaluationComparison. Turn its zero, shift, cone and retract clauses into a triangulated retract-stable object property on the opposite category, then pass to the unop property.

proof.text: For a locally closed generator, obtain finite-projective constant trivializations of its lisse sheaf. The published normalizedComparison supplies seven invertible arrows and their exact six-factor equality to evaluationComparison; the composite is invertible. Exact open extension and exact closed direct image commute with the degree-zero embedding, identifying this derived-shriek generator with the sheaf generator in thick generation.

theorem finiteHomEtale_isIso
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    {n m : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (K M : finiteHomEtale l E X n)
    (hK : finiteTorConstructibleEtale l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X K)
    (hM : finiteTorConstructibleEtale l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X M) :
    IsIso (etaleFiniteHomCanonical l E X h K M)
